description: Lets the agent read, write, edit, delete files, and run shell commands on the host. No credentials.
skill_summary: How to find your way around the WebAgent repository and leave it better than you found it — read CLAUDE.md first, explore by comments, mirror the shared-design consistency markers, follow strict-mode JS discipline, and use the directory signpost map. Load before any task that reads, edits, or extends this repo's source.

levels.cautious: Before any file delete, overwrite, bulk edit, or non-read-only shell command, STOP and ask the user to confirm in plain language what will change — even if they gave a broad instruction. Prefer the smallest reversible step and never act on your own initiative without an explicit go-ahead. (Restarting the server after a change is exempt — use restart_server.)
levels.balanced: Carry out the user's explicit file/shell commands directly, but ask first whenever YOU decide on your own initiative to delete, overwrite, or run something irreversible, and when an action is ambiguous or far-reaching.
levels.trusted: Act decisively on the user's intent without pausing to re-confirm routine writes, edits, or shell commands; only stop for clearly irreversible or repo-wide destructive actions (mass delete, force-push).
